bagPolicy.summary: Small bags are permitted after search; backpacks, large totes, large purses and duffel bags are prohibited. The venue does not give a numeric bag-size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: There are limited paid lots around the venue; the operator encourages carpooling or rideshare.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare for arrival but does not publish a designated loading zone.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue is cashless for purchases, with cash accepted for tips and seasonal coat check. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Email the venue about accessibility or medical needs up to 24 hours before arriving so staff can discuss accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted unless an event specifically notes an exception.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office sells tickets on show nights until capacity is reached. Confirm the individual ticket delivery method for any pickup.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Guests must show current physical government photo ID and submit to a thorough search and pat-down. Show-specific door times are listed with the concert.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
